statements.impact_statement: Reassessed on 2026-10-13 against main aa32f36fcd2f8f728dc86549f28661c4b640a9ed: app/Dockerfile serves Gunicorn HTTP/TCP on port 8080 behind the ALB, app/db.py supplies verified TLS/TCP options to PyMySQL, and the runtime files and dependencies contain no QUIC listener or client path. The OpenSSL QUIC flow-control code remains outside this application's execution path. This assessment applies only to this application's libssl3t64@3.5.7-1~deb13u2, which remains unpatched in existing images containing that package; it is not a package remediation or a live deployment verification. Debian DSA-6531-1 provides the fix in 3.5.7-1~deb13u3, verified in the official Distroless amd64 candidate pinned in app/Dockerfile. Reassess by 2026-10-16: this short bridge permits qualification of that candidate, not waiting for a vendor fix. Verify its official signature, rebuild the image, scan without this VEX, smoke-test HTTP and database TLS, and retire this statement once old images are no longer reused. Reassess immediately if runtime protocols or dependencies change. References: https://openssl-library.org/news/secadv/20260929.txt and https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/DSA-6531-1.
